entities.summary: The Harekrushna Mahtab State Library is a library in the city of Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. This is situated on the Sachivalay Marg, next to State Secretariat. Completed in 1959, it houses the State Library of Odisha and the Public Library for the city of Bhubaneswar. As part of the birth centenary celebration of Mahatma Gandhi, it was named as "Gandhi Bhawan" in 1967. In 1987, it was renamed after the first chief minister of Odisha Harekrushna Mahatab.
